I've attached our vendor onboarding checklist for your convenience. Once we have the attestation and sample invoice, APAC finance will advise PO tagging and whether any additional invoice wording is needed (e.g., reverse charge statement).

Target next steps: please send the attestation + sample invoice by end of week and confirm bank details. I'll follow up with APAC finance for PO config.

Connor / Laura — quick guidance from APAC billing:

- If the supplier is a non-resident invoicing from an overseas entity and is not GST-registered in NZ, we should NOT expect a GST line on the invoice. Tag the PO as "no_nz_gst" and map the spend to the Global Services APAC ledger (APAC:GlobalServices).
- Request the supplier include the following statement on every invoice to Redwood: "Supplier is not registered for NZ GST. Recipient (Redwood) will account for GST under reverse charge where applicable." This helps our local tax team reconcile.
- Evidence needed: the signed attestation (we have), plus one of the following: foreign tax residency certificate or bank statement showing overseas billing entity. The attestation you already have is sufficient to start but please ask Aurora for a tax residency doc if they can provide it.
- PO flow: we can issue PO from Redwood's APAC entity but payments will route to the overseas bank account you provided. Please ensure invoice currency matches the PO currency.

I'll add a PO template link below with the exact PO remarks we need.

Regards,
Michael Grant
